name: web-warm-cream-ai-companion-landing-page
title: Cream Landing Page with Pixel Mascots
whatItIs: A long landing page on warm off-white with a dark serif wordmark, a bold sans headline, dark pill CTA, a browser mockup with small colored character mascots perched on top, a logo marquee and a 'Meet your companion' feature block.
whatItMeans: Soft cream and toy-like characters make AI feel gentle and personable instead of cold. The dotted halftone at the top adds subtle texture.
techniques: Mascots sitting on the edge of the browser mockup as if peeking in
Tight heavy headline against light regular-weight subhead
Grayscale logo strip for trust signals without visual noise
Dark pill buttons as the only strong contrast
Pale dotted texture fading down from the top

vocabulary.definition: Characters placed on top of a UI frame to interact with it.
A row of muted partner or customer logos.
A dot-pattern gradient used as subtle background texture.
